parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) for authentication.

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the label.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. This ID is part of the URL used to access Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, in `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`, the organization ID is `{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
